content.text:
**Finding: deviation (Section 19.2, ¶p0076)** — redline validated and submitted.

- **19.1 / 19.3 / 19.4 / 19.5 are sound:** professional-and-workmanlike plus material conformance warranty, malicious code and Applicable Law compliance, a repair/re-perform/replace-then-refund remedy, and a disclaimer that expressly does not limit express warranties or remedies.
- **The failure is 19.2:** a fifteen-**calendar**-day conformance window running from delivery, with an express statement that Vendor has "no correction or refund obligation" afterwards. That is below the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services), it expires before the fifteen-**business**-day acceptance test period in Section 6.1 closes, and the cut-off threatens to hollow out the Section 19.4 remedy.
- **Fix (preferred position, minimal edit):** ninety days running from acceptance, conformance to documentation and Order Form specifications, and correction of reported nonconformities per Section 19.4 — leaving the existing remedy architecture untouched.
